mapper.select: SELECT mq.id, mq.member_email, mq.quest_id, mq.status, mq.assigned_date, mq.due_date, mq.completed_at, mq.created_by, q.title, q.description, q.type, q.difficulty, q.theme, q.reward, q.urgency, q.due_days FROM tbl_member_quest mq JOIN tbl_quest q ON mq.quest_id = q.quest_id WHERE mq.member_email = #{email} AND mq.assigned_date = #{date} AND q.active = TRUE ORDER BY q.urgency DESC, mq.id ASC

SELECT mq.id, mq.member_email, mq.quest_id, mq.status, mq.assigned_date, mq.due_date, mq.completed_at, mq.created_by, q.title, q.description, q.type, q.difficulty, q.theme, q.reward, q.urgency, q.due_days FROM tbl_member_quest mq JOIN tbl_quest q ON mq.quest_id = q.quest_id WHERE mq.id = #{id} AND mq.member_email = #{email}
SELECT quest_id, title, description, type, difficulty, theme, reward, urgency, due_days, active FROM tbl_quest WHERE type = 'DAILY' AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_member_quest (member_email, quest_id, status, assigned_date, due_date, created_by) VALUES (#{memberEmail}, #{questId}, #{status}, #{assignedDate}, #{dueDate}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN email1 = #{email} THEN email2 ELSE email1 END FROM tbl_couple WHERE email1 = #{email} OR email2 = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_quest (title, description, type, difficulty, theme, reward, urgency, due_days, active) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{type}, #{difficulty}, #{theme}, #{reward}, #{urgency}, #{dueDays}, #{active})
mapper.select: SELECT quest_id, title, description, type, difficulty, theme, reward, urgency, due_days, active FROM tbl_quest WHERE type = 'DAILY' AND active = TRUE ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
